style: Photorealistic editorial photograph of an independent German car workshop. Cool daylight from skylights mixed with warm amber task lamps, clean concrete floor, palette of deep teal-navy, steel grey and small amber accents, natural film grain, shallow depth of field, calm and tidy. No people, no text, no logos, no brand badges, no readable license plates.

images.prompt: A compact unbranded silver-grey hatchback raised on a two-post lift in a tidy workshop bay, low front three-quarter angle, a wall of hand tools softly out of focus in the background.
Macro close-up of a ventilated brake disc and a dark grey brake caliper on a wheel hub with the wheel removed, a torque wrench resting on the floor beside it, very shallow depth of field.

An open generic unbranded car engine bay lit from the side, a rugged tablet leaning on the fender showing an abstract glowing waveform graph without any readable text, a diagnostic cable plugged into the car.
